scope: Operational index of the existing reviewer requirements; no new experiment targets or budget changes. A positive offline result never replaces fresh code review.
checks: All127 normal+6 resource control classifications and every author selftest; retain failures rather than rewriting labels
ACK invalid-boundary diagnostic keeps K6 violation and membership mixed evidence, per R2
ERR clean baseline retains violation; ERR invalid-boundary companion is input_or_scope_invalid with mixed evidence
Tagged invalid-boundary case retains row8 valid-prefix unknown and does not call its histories concretely refuted
Per-property/sub-obligation actual checking versus suspended/post-death exposures and unknown counts are documented and reported
Exhaustion snapshot point and actual/projected history counts are separate; truncation/omission disclosures stay explicit
Undefined-read-data history-dependent gap remains explicit unless independently justified; no new normative claim
Old DUT/driver/checker/results/default limits and original experiment budget remain intact
